title: Gremlins 2: The New Batch
review: Every set and every scene is so full of character. Every performance is silly and exaggerated. Extreme care and attention has been taken, so that there isn't a moment of the film that isn't quirky, wacky, or even zany. The gremlins themselves exist to entertain children, but the human scenes are so dense with workplace jokes for adults, and practical physical comedy. They doubled down on what made {Gremlins} popular, and worked hard to make it more tolerable for the parents watching it with their children. To me it's substantially more fun than the original, nailing its brief. Is this {Robocop} for kids?
